$comment: Architectural rules checked against the graph by `node scripts/arch-doc.mjs check`. A rule naming a component that no longer exists is a violation, not a pass, so renaming a crate cannot silently disable the rule that protects it.

invariants.name: parsing stays pure
invariants.because: travsr-analysis depends on travsr-core and nothing else, so parsing can never reach storage, retrieval or the plugin host. Stated as an INVARIANT in CLAUDE.md and in the crate's own module docs.

invariants.name: one trust boundary
invariants.because: travsr-plugin-host is the only crate in the indexer tier allowed to depend on the plugin wire format, which keeps the trust boundary in exactly one crate. travsr-plugin-sdk is the plugin authoring SDK and sits outside that tier. RFC-011, ADR-017.

invariants.name: the foundation depends on nothing internal
invariants.because: core, config, error, ipc and rerank carry zero travsr-* dependencies, so every other crate can be read against a fixed base.
